title: Figure 12. XOR Cellular Automaton and Its Implementation by Tile-Based Self-Assembly
description: Multi-panel figure: (A) rows of binary tiles at t = 0, 1, 2 computing XOR, beside a small Sierpinski triangle pattern; (B) a tile with inputs x, y and output z = x ⊕ y; (C) four tile types (T-00, T-11, T-01, T-10) assembling on a blue seed row with a "growth" arrow; (D–E) large grids of assembled tiles with error positions marked. Captioned "Figure 12. (top a-e) The XOR Cellular Automaton and Its Implementation by Tile-Based Self-Assembly. (bottom a-e) AFM Images of Algorithmic Self-assembly of Sierpinski Triangle Crystals."
